title: Through Him Who Gives Me Strength

request.style: English, uplifting Christian pop, bright female vocal, piano, synth pads, electric guitar, punchy drums, bass, hopeful and confident, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He wrote a word of thanks to friends who'd sent him help again
He was writing from a prison, he was sitting there in chains
He had known the crowded table and he'd known the empty bowl
But whatever came, a quiet strength was rooted in his soul

[Pre-Chorus]
I have learned to be content whatever my circumstances

[Chorus]
I can do all things through him who gives me strength
I can do all things
Through him who gives me strength

[Verse]
When the paycheck's gone too early and the rent is due again
When the doctor's words are heavy and I cannot see the end
When the house is full of laughter and the cupboards overflow
In every single season he's the only strength I know

[Pre-Chorus]
I have learned to be content whatever my circumstances

[Chorus]
I can do all things through him who gives me strength
I can do all things
Through him who gives me strength

[Bridge]
I know what it is to have little
And I know what it is to have plenty
Whether well fed or hungry
Whether living in abundance or in want

[Chorus]
I can do all things through him who gives me strength
I can do all things
Through him who gives me strength

[Outro]
Through him who gives me strength
